_meta.description: Manipur district & sessions court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal and civil courts in Manipur, supervised by the High Court of Manipur (principal seat at Imphal). Following the 2016 reorganisation, Manipur has 16 districts. English is the working language; Meiteilon (Manipuri) is the State language under the Manipur Official Language Act, 1979.

party_designation.state: State of Manipur through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Manipur, Imphal

case_nomenclature.atrocity_case: Spl. Sessions (SC/ST Atrocities) Case No. _____ of {year}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the petitioner shall, as in duty bound, ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly verify and declare that the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ of the above petition are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ are based on information received and legal advice tendered, which I believe to be true. Nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: English is the language of pleadings before the subordinate judiciary in Manipur; Meiteilon (Manipuri) pleadings with English translation are accepted at the discretion of the court.

Bail applications under S.483 BNSS (formerly S.439 CrPC) before the Sessions Court must disclose any prior rejection by a Magistrate or co-ordinate court; the application must be accompanied by a certified copy of the FIR and the bail order, if any.
Anticipatory bail applications (S.482 BNSS) require certified copy of the FIR and grounds of apprehension; the High Court of Manipur is the preferred forum for serious offences.
Vakalatnama in the form prescribed under the High Court of Manipur Rules with requisite court-fee stamp.
Court-fee under the Court-Fees Act, 1870 as adopted by Manipur with State amendments; ad valorem fee for civil suits.
SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, POCSO and NDPS cases tried by designated Special Courts at the district headquarters.

Hill district matters concerning tribal customary law may engage the Manipur (Village Authorities in Hill Areas) Act, 1956; jurisdiction overlap with Village Authority Courts should be verified before filing.
e_filing_note: e-Filing operational at Imphal via eCourts portal; not yet mandatory state-wide.
